text: Ko wano Men neeminirnoo non e Yuusufa laɓɓingol mo ɓoortindira mo e kaso, Men neeminiri e makko ñimnugol ka leydi Misra, himo jippoo hoɗa e mayri nokku kala ka o yiɗi. Meɗen yeɗa yurmeendeAa Amen nden aduna on mo Men muuyi e jeyaaɓe Amen ɓen. Men yeebataa njoɓdi moƴƴinooɓe ɓen, ko Men timminirooɓe ndi ko aldaa e ɗuytugol.
